descriptions.d15f_property_set_kind0_8034bf50: Sets a kind-0 (unsigned word) property by name on an owner: updates an existing slot when flag bit 0 is set and kind/mode agree (bit 2 adopts the slot's mode), otherwise returns E_FAIL after a notification call; creates, retains and initializes a new 20-byte property when the name is absent, decrements the owner's free count and bumps the global creation counter.
